Natural Grocers® invites customers to celebrate Nevada Day Oct. 30–Nov. 1 at all Nevada locations.


LAKEWOOD, Colo.


, Oct. 27, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Natural Grocers®, the leading family-operated organic and natural grocery retailer in the U.S., invites customers to its annual Nevada Day event, October 30 through November 1 at its[four Nevada stores.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=189444827&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fstore-directory%3Ffield_store_address_administrative_area%3DNV&a=four+Nevada+stores.) {N}power® members are invited to celebrate with a free Natural Grocers reusable tote bag and a $5-off coupon for in-store purchases.


**NATURAL GROCERS – NEVADA** Headquartered in Colorado,[Natural Grocers](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=1748297375&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=Natural+Grocers) expanded into Nevada in 2014. Today Natural Grocers operates four stores in the Silver State, including Reno, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Incline Village.


**NEVADA {N}POWER MEMBERS SAVE & CELEBRATE** Natural Grocers will be celebrating Nevada Day by honoring {N}power members with a freebie and extra savings from October 30–November 1.


- **October 30–November 1:** All {N}power members at Nevada stores will receive a **free** limited-edition reusable shopping bag featuring the states where Natural Grocers operates—including Nevada—while supplies last.\[i\]
- **October 30–November 1:** {N}power members will enjoy extra savings with a **$5-off coupon** .\[ii\]


**SIGN UP & SAVE** Not an {N}power member?[Sign up for {N}power here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=2942622933&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower&a=Sign+up+for+%7BN%7Dpower+here) and enjoy[Even More Affordable PricesSM](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=3337859982&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Feven-more-affordable-prices%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dnpower-even-more-affordable-pricing&a=Even+More+Affordable%C2%A0PricesSM) , discounts and surprise offers. Customers can earn valuable rewards points with every visit.\[iii\]


**A COMMITMENT TO CREW** Natural Grocers provides careers for almost 70 good4uSM Crew members in Nevada. The company is passionate about ensuring that its employees can live a healthy, balanced life and is committed to positively impacting Crew members' physical, emotional and financial well-being through free nutrition education programs, excellent benefits and access to the highest quality products at its Always AffordableSM prices.


- [Learn more about Natural Grocers' career options](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=2602912938&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-careers&a=Learn+more+about+Natural+Grocers%27+career+options) (search by store and state, including Nevada).


**FOLLOW, VISIT AND SUBSCRIBE** To keep up with the latest that Natural Grocers has to offer, follow them on[Facebook](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=2167315392&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FNaturalGrocers%2F&a=Facebook) ,[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=4118974370&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fnaturalgrocers%2F&a=Instagram) ,[TikTok](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=4223917204&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40shopnaturalgrocers%3Flang%3Den&a=TikTok) or[YouTube](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=1843261047&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fuser%2Fnaturalgrocers&a=YouTube) . To learn more about a natural approach to living, monthly sale items, recipes and educational articles, visit[naturalgrocers.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=795990561&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=naturalgrocers.com) ,[download their app](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=4039402136&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnatural-grocers-app&a=download+their+app) , or[subscribe](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=3663349976&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fhealth-hotline-subscription-center%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dhhl-subscription-center&a=subscribe) to the free *Health Hotline® Magazine* from Natural Grocers to learn more about a natural approach to living with monthly sale items, recipes and educational articles.


- For media inquiries, please emailmedia@naturalgrocers.com .


**ABOUT NATURAL GROCERS BY VITAMIN COTTAGE**
Founded in 1955,[Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=2391962133&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=Natural+Grocers+by+Vitamin+Cottage%2C+Inc.) (NYSE: NGVC) is an expanding specialty retailer of natural and organic groceries, body care products and dietary supplements. The grocery products sold by Natural Grocers must meet strict quality guidelines and may not contain artificial flavors, preservatives or sweeteners (as defined by its standards), synthetic colors or partially hydrogenated or hydrogenated oils. The Company sells only USDA-certified organic produce and exclusively pasture-raised, non-confinement dairy products and free-range eggs. Natural Grocers' flexible smaller-store format allows it to offer affordable prices in a shopper-friendly, clean and convenient retail environment. The Company also provides extensive free science-based Nutrition Education programs to help customers and Crew make informed health and nutrition choices. Natural Grocers is committed to its[Five Founding Principles](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=823656620&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-five-founding-principles&a=Five+Founding+Principles) —including its "Commitment to Community" and "Commitment to Crew." In fiscal year 2025, the Company invested more than $16 million in incremental compensation and discretionary payments for Crew. Headquartered in Lakewood, CO, Natural Grocers has 175 stores in 22 states. Visit[naturalgrocers.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=2625215964&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=naturalgrocers.com%C2%A0) for more information and store locations.


\[i\] Offer available only to {N}power members. Limit one bag per customer. Offer only valid 10/30/2026-11/1/2026 at participating Nevada stores, while supplies last. Quantity limited to stock on hand; no rain checks.


\[ii\] Offer available only to {N}power members, for in-store purchases at participating Nevada Natural Grocers stores 10/30/2026-11/1/2026. Customer must load the reward via {N}power email or app prompt before shopping. $5 discount will be applied to product's regular non-discounted price. A minimum purchase is required to use the $5-off coupon. View minimum purchase details via {N}power email or app. Must present phone number at checkout to accumulate towards the minimum requirement in one transaction.


\[iii\] Sign up by 10/28/2026 to receive this coupon via email or app. {N}power offers are available only to registered members and are subject to program terms and conditions available at[www.naturalgrocers.com/npower](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776135-1&h=649855651&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D3526412-1%26h%3D4116486068%26u%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%252Fnpower%26a%3Dwww.naturalgrocers.com%252Fnpower&a=www.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower) and privacy available at[www.naturalgrocers.com/privacy-policy](http://www.naturalgrocers.com/privacy-policy) . Natural Grocers reserves the right to correct errors. Void where prohibited by law. Natural Grocers employees, including members of their household, are not eligible.
